verses.arabicText: قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Qaf wal-qur'āni l-majīd
verses.translation: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...

verses.arabicText: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
verses.transliteration: Bal ʿajibū an jāahum mundhirum-min'hum faqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā shayon ʿajīb
verses.translation: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

verses.arabicText: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: A-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīd
verses.translation: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."

verses.arabicText: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
verses.transliteration: Qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓ
verses.translation: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

verses.arabicText: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
verses.transliteration: Bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrim-marīj
verses.translation: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

verses.arabicText: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Afalam yanẓurū ilā s-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūj
verses.translation: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

verses.arabicText: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahīj
verses.translation: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

verses.arabicText: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Tabṣirataw-wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdim-munīb
verses.translation: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].

verses.arabicText: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wanazzalnā mina s-samāi māam-mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātiw-waḥabba l-ḥaṣīd
verses.translation: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

verses.arabicText: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wal-nakhla bāsiqātil-lahā ṭalʿun-naḍīd
verses.translation: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

verses.arabicText: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
verses.transliteration: Riz'qal-lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatam-maytan kadhālika l-khurūj
verses.translation: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.

verses.arabicText: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
verses.transliteration: Kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw-wa-aṣḥābu r-rasi wathamūd
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud

verses.arabicText: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Waʿāduw-wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭ
verses.translation: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot

verses.arabicText: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba r-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīd
verses.translation: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

verses.arabicText: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsim-min khalqin jadīd
verses.translation: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīd
verses.translation: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein

verses.arabicText: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani sh-shimāli qaʿīd
verses.translation: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.

verses.arabicText: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīd
verses.translation: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
verses.transliteration: Wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīd
verses.translation: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

verses.arabicText: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Wanufikha fī ṣ-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīd
verses.translation: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

verses.arabicText: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Wajāat kullu nafsim-maʿahā sāiquw-washahīd
verses.translation: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.

verses.arabicText: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Laqad kunta fī ghaflatim-min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīd
verses.translation: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

verses.arabicText: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
verses.transliteration: Waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīd
verses.translation: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

verses.arabicText: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīd
verses.translation: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

verses.arabicText: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Mannāʿil-lil'khayri muʿ'tadim-murīb
verses.translation: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi sh-shadīd
verses.translation: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

verses.arabicText: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīd
verses.translation: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīd
verses.translation: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.

verses.arabicText: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmil-lil'ʿabīd
verses.translation: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal mim-mazīd
verses.translation: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

verses.arabicText: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
verses.transliteration: Wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīd
verses.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

verses.arabicText: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓ
verses.translation: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

verses.arabicText: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
verses.transliteration: Man khashiya r-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbim-munīb
verses.translation: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

verses.arabicText: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
verses.transliteration: Ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūd
verses.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

verses.arabicText: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīd
verses.translation: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

verses.arabicText: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.transliteration: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal mim-maḥīṣ
verses.translation: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā s-samʿa wahuwa shahīd
verses.translation: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnā s-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmiw-wamā massanā mil-lughūb
verses.translation: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi sh-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūb
verses.translation: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

verses.arabicText: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.transliteration: Wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra s-sujūd
verses.translation: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

verses.arabicText: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi mim-makānin qarīb
verses.translation: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.transliteration: Yawma yasmaʿūna ṣ-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūj
verses.translation: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīr
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīr
verses.translation: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.transliteration: Naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni may-yakhāfu waʿīd
verses.translation: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
